reference.question: Return the owner id, first name and last name of the owner who has the most dogs.
reference.gold_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id, T2.first_name, T2.last_name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id, T2.first_name, T2.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
